senses.gloss: m. (טוע, cmp. טעי) traveller, esp. Arabian caravan merchant.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 56b:19">Ber. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>ט׳ בעלמא</he> dreaming of an Arab in general (not of Ishmael, the son of Abraham).
<cite ref="Menachot 69b:6">Men. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>כדעדי ט׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>בר עדי</he>) as in the case of Adi the merchant; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 33a:12">Ab. Zar. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>בר עדי ט׳</he>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 102a:14">Yeb. 102ᵃ</cite> <he>סנדלא דט׳ וכ׳</he> a traveller’s sandal which fits closely.—Pl. <he>טַיָּיעֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 36a:12">B. Bath. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>בנהרדעא ט׳ שכיחי</he> in N. Arabs (stealing cattle) are frequent.
